# SIMLAF

> SIMLAF is an audio software maker founded by H. Domboka. It makes audio plug-ins and virtual instruments for music producers and mix engineers, and is building the SIMLAF 2 DAW. Its live division is SIMLAF Audio, and its store opens on 27 November 2026. Engineered by H. Domboka. Website: https://simlaf.com. Contact: hello@simlaf.com.

## The name
SIMLAF has no connection with SimLab Soft, which makes 3D visualization and VR software. SIMLAF makes audio plug-ins, virtual instruments and the SIMLAF 2 DAW.

## What SIMLAF makes
- **Catalogue:** individual instruments and effects (43 products on 27 November 2026, subject to exact release availability). Previous all-company offers are retired from new sales; existing rights are preserved.
- **Individual tools:** SIMLAF Spectral (resonance suppression and spectral dynamics, zero latency by default), KAMILI (mastering chain), KARAKANA (analogue rack), UKWELI 2 (headphone and speaker monitoring in modelled rooms), TECTON 2 (bass amp system, 120 amps), TUFANI (guitar amp suite, 52 amps), AUREL (vocal chain), hCHOP STICKS (drum channel strip), hVOLT (beat and 808 processor), CONSOLA (multiband console saturation), VELUM (keys effects rack), LUMEN (additive resynthesis synth), EMBER (modelled electric pianos), hLUTHIER (acoustic guitar processor), AURA (modelled acoustic piano, 26 instruments), CANTUS 4 (wavetable and FM synthesiser, six operators), NGOMA 2 (physically modelled drums and beat workstation), BARYS (bass synthesiser), THESAUROS (sampler that builds instruments from one sound), ANTIPHON (physically modelled acoustic synthesiser). Planned USD prices and exact release details are on each product page. The store is closed until opening.
- **SIMLAF FX:** a suite of stock effects (EQ, compressor, multiband, limiter, reverb, delay and more), zero latency by default.
- **SIMLAF 2:** a DAW with always-on retrospective recording for audio and MIDI, video for scoring and sound design, and a zero-latency console. Ships December 2026.
- **Free:** SIMLAF Spectral Free, zero-latency resonance suppression, planned for 3 November 2026.

## Platforms
macOS 10.13 or later; built for Intel and Apple Silicon (Apple Silicon testing in progress). Windows: coming December 2026 (UKWELI 2's in January 2027). Linux and mobile apps to follow.
